items.t: Nvidia Boosts Chip Tracking in Southeast Asia to Fight Smuggling
items.d: Nvidia Corp. is stepping up monitoring of AI accelerators sold in Southeast Asia, a strategic step to curtail semiconductor smuggling after criticism it hasn’t done enough to stop shipments from illegally reaching Chinese companies.

items.fullText: 국제 '150억대 엔비디아칩' 싣고 사라졌다…운송트럭 두달째 행방불명 발행일 : 2026-11-06 17:33 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 엔비디아 본사 전경. 사진=연합뉴스 미국 실리콘밸리에서 154억원 상당의 엔비디아 인공지능(AI) 반도체와 관련 장비가 운송 도중 사라져 경찰이 두 달째 수사를 벌이고 있다. 고가의 AI 반도체를 노린 전문 절도단의 소행일 가능성이 제기되는 가운데 아직 화물의 행방은 확인되지 않고 있다. 5일(현지시간) 미국 실리콘밸리 지역매체 머큐리뉴스에 따르면 캘리포니아주 오클랜드 경찰은 지난 8월 29일 오클랜드에서 텍사스주 포트워스로 운송되던 엔비디아 화물 도난 사건을 수사하고 있다. 도난당한 화물은 엔비디아의 AI 반도체와 관련 하드웨어가 실린 적재대 6개 분량으로, 시가는 1140만 달러(약 154억원)에 달한다. 식품 운송회사 로고가 새겨진 트럭은 오클랜드를 출발해 남쪽으로 이동하던 중 연락이 끊겼다. 화물 구매자들은 9월 초 물건이 도착하지 않은 사실을 확인하고 경찰에 신고했다. 경찰은 트럭이 이동 과정에서 여러 차례 수 시간씩 정차한 사실을 파악했지만, 샌버나디노 카운티 인근에서 추적에 실패했다. 전문 절도단의 소행일 가능성에 무게를 두고 수사하고 있으나 아직 체포된 용의자는 없다. 엔비디아 제품이 도난 표적이 된 것은 이번이 처음이 아니다. 지난해에도 750만 달러(약 102억원) 상당의 엔비디아 화물이 사라져 프리몬트와 유니언시티 경찰이 수사에 나섰다. 올해 9월에는 엔비디아 로고가 붙은 대형 트레일러 두 대가 탈취되는 사건도 발생했다. 다만 범인들은 차량에 실린 화물이 고가의 AI 반도체가 아닌 약 18t의 모래라는 사실을 확인한 뒤 트레일러를 버리고 달아났다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

items.fullText: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents See how developers are combining AI agents with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior and guide improvements. November 5, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem. Create Editable 3D Assets With Houdini and AI Agents 🔗 Creating animated 3D content requires connecting modeling, simulation, materials and rendering. Nick Scarcella, a senior technical artist on NVIDIA’s BondLab team, directed AI agents — primarily using Claude — to work with CUDA libraries and Isaac Sim to create animations. The BondLab team uses SideFX Houdini and the NVIDIA ovrtx library to develop materials, lighting and the final rendered appearance. In one experiment, Scarcella guided Astra to recreate an OP-1 portable synthesizer using product images, manuals and technical direction. He exported the model into the OpenUSD framework, tested it in Houdini and Blender, then used Astra and Opus to refine details before adjusting materials and textures for ovrtx rendering. items.fullText: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models With a parakeet, a webcam and a conviction that AI belongs to everyone — how one NVIDIAN became NVIDIA Nemotron’s loudest advocate. November 5, 2026 by Matthew Leib 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Chris Alexiuk has a simple rule about open source AI: If you believe in it, be loud about it. “We should be shouting about this technology from the rooftops,” said Alexiuk, a Toronto-based senior product research engineer in deep learning at NVIDIA who specializes in making open large language models (LLMs) practical for working developers. Alexiuk’s preferred “rooftop” is YouTube , where he’s built a following teaching curious thousands how to build, fine-tune, evaluate and ship production LLM applications and agents. “I think the people who will most help us understand how to build and apply AI likely haven’t even heard of it yet,” he said. “Trying to get knowledge and information out to as many people as humanly possible is what continues to drive me.” Bringing NVIDIA Nemotron to Developers Everywhere Having spent years teaching developers to build with open models, Alexiuk has concluded that transparency isn’t a feature of good AI; it’s the precondition for it. “Fully open source AI is necessary for the democratization of intelligence,” he said. “You should have access to the weights, the data that went into it, the training recipes, everything.” That’s why, on his LinkedIn profile, Alexiuk styles himself “No. 1 Nemotron Fan,” referring to the NVIDIA Nemotron family of open source, multimodal models built for long-running, self-evolving and specialized AI agents. “I think Nemotron is the most important project that exists,” said Alexiuk, who also uses the pseudonym “Joe Nemotron” across social media. “I’m a firm believer that openness is a very important thing to undertake, so I’m going to be the No. 1 fan of whoever is doing that the best. items.fullText: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge November 5, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Larger models, longer contexts and agentic applications are increasing GPU memory pressure while supply tightens and prices rise — a trend expected to continue through the near term. NVIDIA works closely with memory partners to rapidly adopt the latest memory technologies. NVIDIA was first to adopt HBM3e and HBM4 technologies into an accelerated computing stack. But the approach isn’t to simply pack more memory onto the GPU. It’s full-stack codesign. NVIDIA intentionally designs GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage and software together to get more useful work out of memory at every layer of the AI factory. That matters because an AI factory runs on a memory and storage hierarchy. GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) is the fastest, most expensive and most contested tier — with model weights and KV cache competing for limited capacity. Below it sit CPU memory, local SSDs and shared storage, each trading speed for more capacity at a lower cost per bit. How much useful work a byte does depends on how well the whole hierarchy is used: shrinking what must be stored, placing it on the right tier and bringing it back to the GPU before it’s needed. Byte for byte, NVIDIA makes the most efficient use of memory at every layer — and the results show it. From NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra to the Vera Rubin platform, HBM capacity per GPU rose roughly 3%, while agentic throughput per dollar rose by up to 30x on SemiAnalysis AgentX. Agentic Inference Is Putting More Pressure on HBM Frontier models now have trillions of parameters — the values that hold what an AI model learned in training. KV cache, which holds the context the model needs to understand each active request without reprocessing the same information, is also expanding. items.fullText: ‘Hogwarts Legacy’ Gets a Magical NVIDIA DLSS 5 Upgrade on GeForce NOW Look forward to 24 games coming in November, including eight this week, and claim a ‘World of Warcraft: Forever’ launch reward. November 5, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Hogwarts Legacy receives an NVIDIA DLSS 5 upgrade with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering today, bringing lifelike lighting and materials to the wizarding world on GeForce NOW . Blizzard Entertainment’s World of Warcraft: Forever also opens a new chapter in Azeroth, with a launch-week access reward available for GeForce NOW members. Meanwhile, Ubisoft brings fresh challenges with expansions for Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 and Anno 117: Pax Romana . It’s all part of a packed month of play, with two-dozen games joining the GeForce NOW library throughout November, including eight this week. Hogwarts in a New Light NVIDIA DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering arrives in Hogwarts Legacy today, giving members a new reason to return to Hogwarts, streaming from Steam, Epic Games and Xbox with Play Anywhere support. Published by Warner Bros. Games under the Portkey Games label and developed by Avalanche Software, Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action role-playing game set in the 1800s wizarding world. Begin as a fifth-year student, encounter magical creatures, brew potions and learn spells while exploring both recognizable and unfamiliar places. The update adds lifelike lighting and material detail while retaining underlying geometry and textures. Avalanche Software has tuned the integration through DLSS 5’s developer controls to maintain the game’s artistic intent and style. Hogwarts Legacy also includes support for the DLSS Multi Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction features, accelerating and enhancing the ray-traced graphics that immerse players in Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. AI 생태계를 조성한 엔비디아를 통해 국내 AI 스타트업의 해외 진출 길이 열릴지 주목된다. 5일 과학기술정보통신부에 따르면 오는 9일 서울 삼성동 코엑스에서 국내 AI 스타트업 최고경영자(CEO)와 엔비디아 주요 임원 간 비공개 간담회가 열린다. 지난 10월 리사 수 AMD CEO가 방한해 국내 AI 반도체 기업들과 협력 방안을 논의한 데 이어 두 번째다. 엔비디아에서는 젠슨 황 CEO의 장녀인 매디슨 황 수석이사를 포함해 디푸 탈라 로보틱스 및 에지 AI 부문 부사장과 조나단 코헨 응용 연구 부문 부사장 등이 참석한다. 국내에서는 AI 분야의 주요 스타트업이 참석할 예정이다. 리벨리온, 퓨리오사AI, 딥엑스 등 AI 반도체 기업과 업스테이지 등 AI 모델 개발사, 엘리스그룹 등 AI 인프라 기업이 참석 예정 및 검토 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 행사는 엔비디아의 국내 행사 일정에 맞춰 과기정통부와 엔비디아가 국내 AI 스타트업과의 교류를 확대하기 위해 마련했다. 참석자들은 국내 AI 스타트업의 성장과 글로벌 시장 진출 방안, 기술 협력 가능성 등을 논의한다. 지난달 AMD와의 회동 이후 구체적인 성과가 가시화하고 있다. AMD는 국내 스타트업 망고부스트와 손잡고 AI 클라우드 인프라를 구축했으며, 국내 AI 반도체 기업들과 AMD의 중앙처리장치(CPU)·그래픽처리장치(GPU)를 결합한 컴퓨팅 인프라 실증도 추진하고 있다. 이번 엔비디아와의 만남에서도 국내 스타트업이 글로벌 AI 생태계에 참여하고 기술 상용화와 해외 고객사 확보 등으로 협력 범위를 넓힐 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 과기정통부 관계자는 “간담회뿐 아니라 개별 기업과의 미팅도 논의 중이며, 구체적인 협력 방안은 현장에서 논의할 예정”이라고 말했다. 이영애 기자 0ae@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이영애 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 "너무 비싸게 샀나"…마벨, 루멘텀 인수발표 후 급락 한국경제신문의 투자 전문 유료 플랫폼 '한경 프리미엄9'에 실린 기사입니다. 한경 프리미엄9(www.hankyung.com/premium9)을 구독하시면 더 많은 글로벌 투자 기사를 찾아볼 수... 2026.11.03 17:54 2 제이 리터 "앤트로픽·오픈AI는 좋은 기업…하지만 좋은 주식은 아닐 수도" 한국경제신문의 투자 전문 유료 플랫폼 '한경 프리미엄9'에 실린 기사입니다. 한경 프리미엄9(www.hankyung.com/premium9)을 구독하시면 더 많은 글로벌 투자 기사를 찾아볼 수... 2026.11.02 18:03 3 '근원 경쟁력' 회복한 삼성…AI 전환·미래 투자 속도전 “오늘의 삼성을 넘어 진정한 초일류 기업을 만듭시다. 제가 그 앞에 서겠습니다.”이재용 삼성전자 회장이 회장직에 오른 2022년 10월 27일 삼성 사내 게시판에 ‘미래를 위한 도전&... 2026.10.25 18:34 ADVERTISEMENT 많이 본 뉴스 1 "2000원짜리에 또 난리났다"…다이소 갔더니 '품절입니다' 2026.11.04 19:28 2 150억에 회사 넘긴 노현정 남편…장례식장 647곳 손잡은 이유 2026.11.04 21:07 3 '진작 담아두길 잘했네' 개미들 환호…하루 만에 18% 터졌다 20

items.fullText: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI From infrastructure planning and transportation to public services, cities are using NVIDIA-powered applications to address local needs and expand capacity for the broader AI ecosystem. November 2, 2026 by Esther Lee 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Cities generate enormous amounts of data from cameras, sensors and operational systems, but turning it into useful action — for planning, maintenance and public services — remains a challenge. Physical and agentic AI offer new ways to close that gap, from digital twins for infrastructure planning to vision and service agents, while keeping local governments in control of how sensitive data is processed and used. Building on initiatives announced at GTC Berlin , NVIDIA and its partners are expanding physical AI and AI agents to cities worldwide. Shared computing infrastructure gives city departments, neighboring municipalities and local developers a common foundation to build on — extending services without each organization having to acquire and manage resources of their own. Agentic AI for Cities From resident services to vision agents, cities are adopting NVIDIA agentic AI to deliver faster, more responsive public services. City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough. In Spain, 1MillionBot combines open source ALIA models trained at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center with NVIDIA Nemotron and other models in resident-service agents for Madrid Digital (Comunidad de Madrid), Administració Oberta de Catalunya and 150+ deployments across Spain, handling municipal procedures, appointment requests, urban-planning incidents and service inquiries. items.fullText: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future Jensen Huang’s visit to the nation’s capital, Astana — including a presidential meeting and public fireside chat — coincided with new AI infrastructure commitments anchored by NVIDIA compute. October 22, 2026 by Rev Lebaredian 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kazakhstan’s AI ecosystem is moving from infrastructure plans to deployment. The shift is visible across the full AI stack — from infrastructure to models to applications. The announcements below — coinciding with a visit to Astana by NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang — point to the nation’s increasing supply of accelerated computing, along with its growing demand for what comes next. On Friday, Oct. 23, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang visited Astana, meeting with President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev at the Akorda Presidential Palace and joining Deputy Prime Minister Zhaslan Madiyev — Kazakhstan’s minister of AI and digital development — for a public fireside chat at the Alem.AI program. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Jensen Huang and Kazakhstan’s AI Minister Speak at Alem.AI In their fireside chat at Alem.AI, Kazakhstan’s international center for artificial intelligence, Madiyev and Huang discussed the country’s push to become an AI nation — building the energy and computing infrastructure to support homegrown AI and applying it across the economy. Madiyev said Kazakhstan wants AI that reflects its language and culture. “We want AI that understands and speaks Kazakh and captures cultural contexts and cultural specifics,” he said, describing the country’s work on Kazakh-language models. Huang said Kazakhstan could turn its energy resources into a foundation for AI production — and a new kind of export. “Instead of just exporting energy, in the future, you could transform energy into intelligence and export intelligence,” he said. items.fullText: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories New AIOps platform connects infrastructure and workload telemetry to help operators increase uptime and maximize AI factory yield. October 22, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast numbers of GPUs working across high-speed networks to train models and serve AI applications. At that scale, a single degraded component can slow an entire job. The warning signs may be easy to miss, such as a GPU running hotter than its peers or an NVMe drive losing performance under load. The platform focuses on AI factory yield, a measure of the useful work infrastructure produces through GPU hours, goodput, cluster uptime and token production. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Delivering a Dynamic View of an AI Factory Traditional monitoring tools often divide the data center into separate views. Networking, compute, site reliability and machine learning teams each see a different part of the operation. Minerva connects those signals across NVIDIA GPUs, networking, storage, schedulers and workloads. With these signals, Minerva builds a dynamic knowledge graph that logically maps the infrastructure — GPUs, SuperNICs, switches and cables — and the jobs running on it. This context helps operators trace a slow training job to the component affecting it, even across a factory with hundreds of thousands of GPUs. items.fullText: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence From transaction foundation models to sovereign cloud deployments, leading financial institutions across Europe are scaling intelligent technologies with advanced computing. October 21, 2026 by Jason Renders 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! At GTC Berlin, banks, payment companies and financial data providers are showing what production-scale intelligence looks like — built on NVIDIA accelerated computing, powered by open weight models and running on their own infrastructure. Revolut is rebuilding its technology stack on a single foundation model PRAGMA , powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing. Using the NVIDIA cuDF toolkit and Dynamo-Triton software on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs , Revolut is scaling PRAGMA in production, servicing an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x. “Revolut processes billions of transactions — the opportunity was always there, but the question was whether foundation models could operate at that scale and across domains. items.fullText: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck Companies around the world are using the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run AI factories as one system and unlock infrastructure development. October 21, 2026 by Vladimir Troy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem. Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues. One root cause of the bottleneck is siloed systems. The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements To help address this, NVIDIA DSX brings these systems together: NVIDIA DSX Sim and SimReady assets from leading energy manufacturers let engineers simulate the grid, substation and AI factory together, validating generators, switchgear, power systems and cooling before breaking ground. NVIDIA DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions and onsite generation, turning AI factories from static loads into flexible grid assets. NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS and DSX Exchange squeeze more compute from every watt and securely share signals across compute, networking, energy, cooling and operations. GE Vernova is deploying its grid-to-facility and rack power expertise to complement NVIDIA DSX systems, enabling customers to transform power constraints into competitive advantages while maximizing compute and token output, sustainability and grid reliability. items.fullText: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations October 21, 2026 by Mavi Nafria 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. items.fullText: 본문 경제 IT 엔비디아, 네이버 3대 주주 됐다…1조3400억 납입 완료 선담은 기자 수정 2026-11-06 20:12 펼침 0:00 Your browser does not support the audio element. 아시아·유럽·중동 겨냥 AI 팩토리 투자 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 지난 6월8일 경기 성남시 네이버 제2사옥 ‘1784’를 방문해 자신을 향해 인사하는 네이버 직원들을 바라보고 있다. 네이버 제공 광고 엔비디아가 네이버에 10억달러(약 1조3412억원) 규모의 투자금 납입을 완료했다. 이에 따라 엔비디아는 네이버의 3대 주주(지분율 4.13%)에 올랐다. 네이버는 6일 엔비디아를 대상으로 한 제3자 배정 유상증자를 통해 보통주 655만8천435주를 발행하고, 대금 1조3411억9995만7500원이 전액 납입됐다고 공시했다. 앞서 네이버는 지난달 30일 엔비디아를 대상으로 10억달러 규모의 제3자 배정 유상증자를 실시한다고 공시했다. 이후 지난 3일 최종 발행 주식 수를 확정했다. 신주 발행 예정일은 오는 27일이다. 광고 네이버는 이번 유상증자로 확보한 자금을 통해 엔비디아 및 글로벌 자산운용사 브룩필드와 손잡고 아시아와 유럽·중동 지역을 겨냥한 글로벌 인공지능(AI) 팩토리 사업에 투자한다는 계획이다. 네이버는 엔비디아의 10억달러 투자 유치를 통해 최첨단 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 공급·기술 협력을 확대하고, 브룩필드로부터는 90억달러를 조달해 기가와트(GW)급 AI 팩토리 운영에 필요한 인프라와 공급망을 조성하게 된다. 광고 광고 네이버는 내년 상반기 자사 데이터센터 ‘각 세종’에서 55메가와트(MW) 규모의 인프라 가동을 시작으로 인공지능 팩토리 관련 매출을 창출할 예정이다. 선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr
